jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description
Minerra Health is an integrated metabolic-care platform that unifies behavioral, medical, and surgical care pathways through an intelligent system powered by MIRA and MIND. Using AI-driven guidance, human coaching, and clinical support, Minerra Health delivers personalized engagement, real-time insights, and continuous learning across the full care journey. The organization partners with employers, health systems, payers, and TPAs to improve outcomes, lower costs, and expand access to evidence-based obesity care for diverse populations. With specialties in metabolic and obesity care, AI-driven navigation, clinical intelligence, digital care engagement, and population health, Minerra Health focuses on measurable impact in smarter metabolic care.
Role Description
The Operations Project Manager is a remote role responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing cross-functional projects that support the operations and client success of Minerra Health’s integrated metabolic-care platform. This role oversees project timelines, tasks, and deliverables, ensuring operational processes are efficient, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing project plans, tracking milestones, managing risks and issues, and coordinating with clinical, technical, and business teams to maintain clear communication and accountability. The Operations Project Manager will also monitor operational performance metrics and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, delivery and client satisfaction.
Working Hours:
Primarily U.S. business hours with limited India-hours overlap as required
Compensation:
Commensurate with experience and capabilities
Reports To:
Vice President, Operations & Client Success
The Role Minerra Health is seeking a highly organized, persistent, and execution-oriented Operations Project Manager
based in India to support our U.S. operations and client success, as well as cross-functional product, clinical, and implementation activities.
This is not a role for someone who simply schedules meetings, takes notes, and updates project plans.
We need someone who drives work forward
.
A major responsibility of this position is maintaining visibility into commitments across Minerra Health and our clients, identifying what needs to happen next, following up relentlessly but professionally, and ensuring critical operational and client-support activities do not stall.
You will work closely with the Vice President of Operations & Client Success and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Data/Analytics, Marketing, Sales, and client teams in some aspect.
You should be comfortable asking:
What is the next action? Who owns it? When is it due? What is blocking it? What needs to happen to get it completed?

Then you should stay with the issue until it is resolved.
The right person is resourceful, highly dependable, comfortable operating across time zones, and motivated by getting things done.

What You'll Do1. Project & Program Management Manage multiple operational, implementation, and client initiatives simultaneously.
Responsibilities include:
Build and maintain project plans, workplans, milestones, dependencies, and timelines.
Translate meetings, discovery sessions, and leadership discussions into specific tasks and deliverables.
Assign and track owners, deadlines, dependencies, and completion status.
Maintain Jira projects, tickets and related documentation.
Keep Confluence project documentation organized, current, and usable.
Maintain action-item trackers and decision logs.
Monitor scope, timelines, deliverables, and risks.
Identify projects or tasks that are beginning to slip before deadlines are missed.
Escalate blockers with clear recommendations for resolution.
Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Data, Marketing, and Client Success.
Support implementation plans for new clients, products, workflows, and operational programs.
Maintain visibility across multiple projects without losing important details.

You should be comfortable taking a loosely structured initiative and turning it into an organized execution plan.
2. Action-Item Ownership & Follow-Through This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.
You will help create accountability across internal and external teams.
You will:
Capture commitments made during meetings.
Clearly document the owner and expected completion date.
Follow up before deadlines rather than waiting until something becomes late.
Maintain visibility into outstanding deliverables.
Proactively contact internal and external stakeholders when information or action is required.
Escalate overdue or blocked items appropriately.
Close the loop when work has been completed.
Ensure decisions and changes are reflected in project documentation.

Success means leadership does not have to repeatedly ask, "Whatever happened with that?"

Your job is to already know the answer.
3. Client Success & Implementation Support Support Minerra Health's relationships with U.S.-based healthcare organizations.
Responsibilities may include:
Coordinate client deliverables and follow-up activities.
Maintain client project plans and action registers.
Prepare agendas, meeting notes, status reports, and follow-up communications.
Track implementation requirements and dependencies.
Support discovery and workflow documentation.
Coordinate activities involving clinical, technical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
Help prepare materials for client presentations, operating reviews, and executive discussions.
Identify client risks and unresolved issues requiring leadership attention.
Maintain professional and responsive communication with client stakeholders.

The successful candidate will understand that small operational details can have significant consequences for client confidence.
4. Meeting Management Meetings should produce decisions and actions—not simply notes.
You will:
Help develop agendas before meetings.
Identify outstanding decisions and actions that need discussion.
Capture decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines.
Distribute concise meeting summaries.
Enter resulting work into Jira or appropriate trackers.
Follow up on commitments between meetings.
Bring unresolved items back to the appropriate team or leader.

Over time, you will independently manage recurring operational and project meetings.
5. Executive & Presentation Support Help translate operational work into clear executive communication.
You may:
Develop and update PowerPoint presentations.
Prepare project status summaries.
Create timelines and executive dashboards.
Summarize project risks and decisions.
Prepare materials for client and leadership meetings.
Consolidate information from multiple teams into concise updates.
Perform research and analysis supporting strategic initiatives.

You should be able to take complicated information and make it understandable.

What We're Looking ForExperience Ideally, you have:
Approximately 2–5 years of experience
in project management, program coordination, operations, implementation, consulting, client success, or a related discipline.
Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience managing deadlines, dependencies, and action items.
Experience working remotely with distributed teams.
Strong written and spoken English.
Experience working with U.S.-based organizations or clients is strongly preferred.
Startup, technology, healthcare, consulting, SaaS, or digital-health experience is helpful but not mandatory.

Healthcare experience is valuable, but execution ability is more important than healthcare credentials
.
Education A bachelor's degree in business, project management, healthcare administration, engineering, technology, or a related field is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate
.
We value demonstrated capability over credentials.
A candidate with a modest academic background and an exceptional record of execution may be a stronger fit than someone with advanced degrees who requires constant direction.

Required Skills Candidates should demonstrate strong capability in:
Project management
Task and dependency tracking
Written business communication
Meeting facilitation and documentation
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft PowerPoint
Microsoft Word
Jira or comparable project-management software
Confluence or comparable knowledge-management software
Process and workflow documentation
Status reporting
Risk and issue tracking
Stakeholder management
Remote collaboration

Experience with HubSpot, Mixpanel, healthcare systems, EHRs, CRM platforms, analytics tools, or AI productivity tools is a plus.

Working Hours Because this role supports U.S.-based operations and clients, candidates must be willing and able to work primarily during U.S. business hours.

The schedule will require significant overlap with the U.S. team and U.S. client meetings.
There may also be limited situations where overlap with India-based team members is necessary for handoffs, coordination, or project execution.
Candidates should consider this requirement carefully before applying. This is not a traditional India daytime position.
How You Work We are looking for someone who:
Takes ownership.

You do not assume someone else is tracking an issue.
Follows through.

If someone promises something Tuesday, you know whether it arrived Wednesday.
Is persistent without being abrasive.

You are comfortable following up repeatedly when necessary while maintaining professional relationships.
Anticipates problems.

You raise risks before they become missed deadlines.
Creates structure from ambiguity.

Startup projects are not always perfectly defined. You can turn incomplete information into an organized plan.
Pays attention to details.

Names, dates, numbers, versions, owners, and commitments matter.
Communicates concisely.

You can tell leadership what happened, what is outstanding, why it matters, and what decision is needed.
Is comfortable asking questions.

You do not pretend to understand something you do not understand.
Gets things done.

Progress matters more than activity.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud & Compliance Advisory
jobs.description:
About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.

But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.

We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary

The Advisory senior project manager is a full-time position responsible for end-to-end project life cycle management. The Senior Project Manager will be working directly with the Cloud, Compliance Advisory, and Cloud Maintenance & Operations delivery teams. The Senior Project Manager will collaborate with these teams to successfully deliver projects within the defined scope, on time, and on budget. The Senior Project Manager works with all stakeholders in building client relationships and managing escalated issues appropriately. The Senior Project Manager is expected to work independently with little supervision over their daily activities.

What You'll Do

Owns the full lifecycle of projects: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment for multiple initiatives simultaneously

Serves as the main point of contact for the customer and the Coalfire team throughout the project. 

Prepares project plans for all phases of the project with appropriate level of detail

Works with Resource Deployment Managers to secure resources to achieve project objectives in planned schedule

Collaborates alongside the core consultant to manage the day-to-day activities and resources on project engagements; there is a shared responsibility with the core consultant for project scope, budget, timelines, and change management

Understands how to seamlessly align technology, operations, and business needs while successfully utilizing best-practice project management principles, methods, and techniques

Manages project expectations and risks while tracking deliverables with project team members and stakeholders. 

Will monitor, track and control open action items, issues, conflicts, and dependencies

Escalates issues when necessary and follows escalation through to resolution. 

Provides internal status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks/issues, actions, and overall summary information

Develops and delivers progress reports, requirements documentation, and presentations to various audiences (i.e.- project team, sponsors, and key stakeholders) plus any other reporting needs as requested

Attends, prepares for, and leads any meetings as needed: client facing and internal weekly status meetings, steering committee/executive status meetings, daily standups, cloud advisory board meetings, and any other meetings as needed

Works with a team of matrixed employees to deliver top-tier customer service

Ensures that projects and programs are proceeding according to established quality standards. 

Effectively applies Coalfire methodology and enforces project standards. Provides feedback on process changes and improvements

Drives accountability across the internal and external project team

Manages multiple initiatives simultaneously and be able to delegate tasks as needed

Performs other duties as assigned and maintains company defined billable utilization targets. 

Remote position; travel for client or internal work as needed (up to 20%)

What You'll Bring

7+ Years of client-facing, direct project management experience is required. Internal only project management experience cannot count as a substitute

5+ Years of experience working with business stakeholders within a cross-functional matrix environment is required

Proven experience with large clients, complex projects, and executive level interactions required

Proven excellence with customer service skills is required

Demonstrated understanding of Project Management methodology: including both waterfall and agile methodologies is required

Proven excellence with both client-facing and internal communication skills is required

PMP, CSM, PgMP, or related project management certification

Ability to learn new tools quickly or experience with Smartsheet, Jira, and OpenAir

Leadership skills, the ability to own project success, and proven consistency on meeting deliverables and commitments

Able to structure and lead cross-functional teams and stakeholders through the full life cycle of projects

Ability to self-manage in a fast paced and dynamic environment

Ability to provide fulltime support to the delivery teams based in the United States

Base level understanding of the FedRAMP, DoD, CMMC, ISO, SOC, or HITRUST compliance frameworks 

Bachelor’s degree or associate degree plus equivalent experience in project management, business administration, or a related field of study. 

US citizenship (required due to client contractual requirements)

Bonus Points

2+ Years of experience working in a client facing, professional services industry is preferred

Experience running sprint planning meetings, daily stand ups, and retrospectives is preferred

Why You’ll Want to Join Us

At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.

Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.

At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at HumanResourcesMB@coalfire.com.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Project Manager, AMI
jobs.description:
At E Source, we help utilities make sense of complexity in a rapidly changing landscape, and we're looking for a Project Manager to help shape how that impact shows up in the world.

E Source is a research, data/analytics, and technology focused professional services firm focused exclusively on the utility industry in the US and Canada. We help utilities target and serve their customers more effectively, enhance and optimize their grid, and leverage operating best practices and technologies to manage their business more effectively. Headquartered in Texas, we have 450+ employees across the US and Canada. Learn more at www.esource.com

As a Project Manager, you'll lead complex utility technology initiatives for electric, gas, and water clients. Engagements may include AMI (advanced metering infrastructure) feasibility studies, business cases, planning, procurement, implementation, and deployment support. You'll be responsible for planning and coordinating projects from initiation through implementation, balancing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, vendors, and client expectations. Our AMI engagements span the full implementation lifecycle and may include solution design, system integration, testing, meter and network deployment, operational readiness, change management, and transition to ongoing operations. You'll work closely with utility executives and project teams, E Source technical specialists, AMI and software vendors, system integrators, and field deployment contractors to keep programs aligned and moving forward.

In This Role, You Will

Lead day-to-day project management for complex AMI and related utility technology initiatives.
Develop and manage integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, dependencies, resources, and deliverables.
Coordinate activities across client teams, E Source subject matter experts, AMI vendors, system integrators, field deployment contractors, and other third parties.
Manage project risks, issues, decisions, actions, assumptions, and changes, driving timely resolution and escalation as appropriate.
Facilitate project meetings, executive updates, workshops, and cross-functional working sessions.
Monitor vendor performance and contractual commitments, including milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance activities.
Coordinate across AMI workstreams such as meter and network deployment, systems integration, testing, data readiness, operational readiness, and customer-facing activities.
Provide clear, decision-oriented reporting on project status, schedule, budget, risks, issues, and upcoming decisions.
Maintain effective project documentation and governance, while building trusted client relationships and identifying opportunities to provide additional value.
Forecast project resource needs and maintain resource bookings, and monitor project financial performance to support accurate, timely monthly client invoicing and revenue forecasting.

You’re Likely a Great Fit If You

Are skilled at coordinating complex, cross-functional technology implementations involving utility business teams, IT and/or OT organizations, vendors, system integrators, and field resources.
Bring strong facilitation skills and can communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and field personnel.
Can identify emerging project challenges, develop practical courses of action, facilitate decisions, and drive issues through resolution.
Act as an effective bridge between business, operational, and technical teams.
Are comfortable working independently in environments where all information may not yet be available, and can maintain momentum across complex initiatives.
Work effectively in hybrid, virtual, and in-person environments, collaborating with geographically distributed client and project teams.

And Even Better If You

Have a PMP or comparable project-management certification.
Have experience with Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling tools.
Have experience across multiple phases of the AMI lifecycle.

Experience And Skills To Qualify Include

Five or more years of project or program management experience within the utility industry.
Demonstrated experience managing or supporting an advanced metering infrastructure implementation for an electric, gas, or water utility.
Working knowledge of AMI program components such as meters and endpoints, communications networks, head-end systems, meter data management systems, systems integration, testing, deployment, data management, and operational readiness.
Experience managing complex project schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and executive reporting.
Proficiency with project-management tools and Microsoft Office applications.
Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

At E Source, you’ll work alongside people who are thoughtful, curious, and deeply knowledgeable about utility and energy systems. We value clarity over jargon, substance over flash, and collaboration over ego. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and help shape a company that plays a real role in how the energy future unfolds.

What You Can Expect

Excellent insurance options, including medical, dental, and vision plans; company-paid life insurance; company-paid long- and short-term disability insurance; medical and dependent-care flexible spending plans, and paid parental leave.
A flexible time off (FTO) policy that provides paid time away from work, approved by your manager, while ensuring business needs, workload commitments, and appropriate coverage are maintained.
A 401(k) plan with a 3% employer match.

The budgeted salary for this position is $140,000 – $170,000 USD + annual bonus.
Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience.

This role is remote when not traveling to client sites. Travel is dependent on project and client needs (up to 50%).

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US or Canada. We’re unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas or Labour Market Impact Assessments (Cdn) at this time.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employees of E Source are encouraged to apply. To foster a positive work environment and company culture, we support our employees in their career growth at E Source. If you are interested in similar job opportunities in the future, visit the E Source careers page for a listing of all open positions and contact Human Resources.

We contact applicants directly via email using only our designated company email addresses with the domain of @esource.com. Please do not provide personal information to anyone over email and be wary of other accounts impersonating businesses.

The PM manages a project from kickoff to postmortem, working directly with the Account Management team, the client, and internal agency stakeholder to clarify program design, execution, and logistical details. The PM executes the strategy that supports service delivery excellence, client profitability and client satisfaction, and makes use of best practices across all project and client accounts.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Works with the Account and Project Coordination team to define project scope, project specs, and project timeline; develops timelines and manages updates.
Ensures client objectives are followed and met throughout the project development and delivery process.
Maintains a proficient level of brand(s) knowledge.
Leads project kick-off meetings within the agency and with external vendors, as appropriate.
Prepares internal status agendas and leads internal agency status; prepares client status agendas for review, participates in or co-leads client status meetings, captures notes, and drafts recaps.
Manages Project Coordinator(s) workload and supports career growth and skill development.
Collaborates with the Medical, Editorial, Creative, and Operations teams in the delivery of programs to ensure all internal stakeholders have a full understanding of the project scope, deliverables, and due dates.
Thinks strategically and takes a proactive approach to problem-solving; flags potential project pitfalls and/or quality issues; assists in problem resolution and collaborates with team members to initiate solutions.
Manages MLR/PRC submission process working with Project Coordinator/Traffic; leads communications with MLR/PRC team as appropriate; understands submission process and compliance requirements, reporting and documentation.
Participates in resource planning sessions, works with other department leads to prioritize work, fills resource gaps and anticipates future resource needs.
Communicates effectively and efficiently with internal and external stakeholders.
Serves as day-to-day contact with KOL/faculty; drafts KOL/faculty communications; supports KOL contracting.
Reviews own and Project Coordinator’s work for quality and accuracy, ensures all quality control measures (e.g., editorial review, graphics review) are completed within the standard operating procedures.
Supports financial management, development of proposals and SOWs, manages budget tracking, including tracking of external invoices, runs Replicon reports, and leads reconciliation process.
Develops client communications and supportive program materials (ie, invitations, consultant contracts, confirmations, etc.).
Maintains electronic and paper files for all projects.
Executes all aspects of administrative responsibilities (timesheets, status updates, etc.) in appropriately detailed and timely manner.
Understands the regulations/guidelines of the AMA, OIG, PhRMA and ACCME regarding the development of promotional and educational programming.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or related field.
Minimum of 3 years’ experience in program management preferably in a medical communication agency setting within the pharmaceutical arena.
Basic to intermediate skill level in Microsoft Office Suite, Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Intermediate to advanced skill level in PowerPoint.
Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Positive, effective communicator – both written and oral, internal and external.
Thorough understanding of project workflow and prioritization strategies; PMP certification a plus.
Ability to work well on a diverse team and collaborate with other team members of all levels to achieve best results.
Solutions oriented thinker with high attention to detail

jobs.title: Project Manager - Prestige Homes

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

Focus Global’s mission is to touch 100 million homes across Southeast Asia with our lifestyle retail brands. We are transforming the consumer experience through an omnichannel approach - integrating our best-in-class online and offline touchpoints and usingw data to hyper-personalize customer journeys. Focus Global is rapidly growing across e-commerce and physical retail fronts, and are powering this exponential growth with technology.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager who can bridge the gap between business strategy and engineering execution. You’ll work closely with developers, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality systems and tools — from e-commerce features to internal automation platforms.

You will take ownership of the entire project lifecycle — from scoping and planning to execution, testing, and results analysis. Your goal is to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, guide teams through structured delivery processes, and ensure that initiatives are completed efficiently, on time, and with measurable impact.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation (e.g., former software engineer or technical product manager) who enjoys solving problems holistically — not just in code.

What You’ll Do:

Project Initiation & Planning

Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, milestones, and deliverables.
Conduct user needs analysis through quantitative and qualitative methods (e.g., interviews, time studies, data analysis).
Evaluate technical feasibility and trade-offs with engineering leads.
Develop detailed project plans that prioritize tasks, define timelines, and identify dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Align business targets, marketing initiatives, and operational goals with project outcomes.

Execution & Delivery

Manage sprint cycles, backlog grooming, and release coordination.
Track project progress using agile tools (e.g., JIRA, Notion, or Linear).
Assign and monitor project tasks, follow up on blockers, and manage resource allocation and costs.
Conduct daily/weekly syncs, pre-launch reviews, and post-mortems for key releases.
Ensure adherence to testing, QA, and deployment standards to maintain high delivery quality.
Drive continuous improvement in delivery velocity, technical quality, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work with cross-functional teams in software engineering, design, marketing, and analytics.
Translate technical details into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders.
Manage communication with internal and external partners, ensuring transparency and expectation alignment.
Coordinate with third-party vendors, QA testers, and operations teams as needed.

Metrics & Reporting

Track and analyze key delivery metrics (e.g., cycle time, deployment frequency, defect rates).
Prepare structured reports for leadership, covering project progress, risks, and resource allocation.
Use data and feedback loops to recommend improvements and guide product roadmaps.

Qualifications:

3+ years of experience in technical project management, product management, or software engineering.
Solid understanding of web development technologies (e.g., JavaScript, React, Node, Python, or PHP).
Experience in managing e-commerce platforms, internal tools, or automation systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable reading logs, tracing issues, or interpreting API specs.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like JIRA or Notion.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred, but not required:

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), or cloud platforms (AWS, GCP).
Background in QA, DevOps, or systems integration projects.
Knowledge of Flask, .NET, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript.
Experience using data analytics and customer insights to drive feature and UX improvements.

You are an ideal candidate if you are:

Technically fluent – you can read code, understand architecture diagrams, and speak the language of engineers
Execution-focused – structured, organized, and relentless about delivering on time and with quality
Analytical & detail-oriented – you don’t just track tasks; you anticipate dependencies and prevent problems
Collaborative & communicative – able to align diverse teams toward a shared goal
Continuous learner – eager to refine both technical and management skills as the company scales

Why This Role Is a Great Growth Step

Leverage your engineering background to influence broader decisions — from architecture trade-offs to delivery strategy
Expand your scope beyond coding into cross-functional leadership and business impact
Build high-value career capital for future paths in Product Management, Program Management, or Technical Leadership
Work across multiple domains — e-commerce, automation, and internal tools — giving you exposure to how tech drives every part of the business
Learn modern delivery practices in an environment that values autonomy, clarity, and rapid iteration

jobs.title: Program Manager- Launch Platforms
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch seeks a Program Manager to deliver reliable and successful launch platform projects and flight-ready aircraft capability to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible for meeting schedule, cost, and technical objectives for all launch platform service-center related work. Candidates must have a strong sense of urgency, be dedicated to delivering to our customers, and be motivated to drive cross-functional teams to successfully operate our launch platforms. This role requires creative problem solving to significantly increase hypersonic test cadence while also driving affordability into mission operations. This role will require you to roll up your sleeves and work with a multi-faceted team to deliver for customers in a challenging operational environment.

You will work for the Stratolaunch Program Management department. In this role, you will own the integration of all Stratolaunch launch platform service-center projects. Launch platforms are both certified and experimental aircraft. You will own the cost, schedule, and technical integration of all launch platform activities. This includes managing schedules, planning cross-functional resources and staffing, creating budgets and forecasts, mitigating risks experienced in flight test, and delivering aircraft ready to achieve all test objectives. An optimal candidate will have a strong operational background in flight test execution, with experience modifying and integrating new technologies onto launch platforms. You will be responsible for drastically increasing our launch platform flight cadence, while also driving reliability and affordability initiatives into all launch platform projects. This role requires supporting flight test at all hours of the day and some travel to support global operations. You will work with the Stratolaunch finance and accounting office, operations team, and engineering team.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead the execution and integration of all launch platform service-center projects, delivering on-schedule, on-budget, and with completion of all project objectives.
Own launch platform risks. Mitigate the flight test risks and drive issues to closure with timely actions to ensure positive results are delivered to our customers.
Lead the service-center integration of one-off aircraft modification and aircraft maintenance projects.
Develop schedules and resource plans to complete all elements of launch platform execution.
Track maintenance and special-project costs over time and analyze variances. Accountable for achieving the launch platform budgets.
Support and plan for all variable flight costs, including fuel, maintenance, flight crew proficiency flights, etc.
Drive affordability and efficiency into launch platform execution to increase mission profitability.
Lead Program Reviews for all launch platforms.
Serve as a program representative in internal and customer-facing meetings, as required.
Work with Finance and company leadership to ensure planning and financial tracking processes and procedures meet US Government contracting requirements.
Develop and drive critical program management launch platform metrics for the program.
Coordinate and help resolve program financial challenges, as required.
Support the preparation of business proposals to the US Government and industry.
Travel, as required, to support launch platform execution.
Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity, and fulfillment of commitments.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

Knowledge of, and experience with, both certified and experimental heavy aircraft.
Knowledge of, and experience with, one or more of these disciplines: Flight and/or launch vehicle testing, aircraft maintenance, heavy aircraft integration and testing, flight test scheduling and cost tracking.
Experience leading and working with engineers, technicians, testers, and customers to deliver flight-ready aircraft.
Experience developing schedules and managing teams who are motivated to achieve challenging test goals.
Experience with program financial analysis, including variance analysis and developing forecasts.
Experience with driving risk and issues to closure in a timely manner.
Ability to develop and analyze data, and present findings to customers and management.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and ability to implement sound critical thinking skills.
Ability to work on their own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals.
Ability to work under tight deadlines, managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and changing environment.
Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

EDUCATION

Staff-level ($128,000-$206,000): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 10-20 years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Principal-level ($147,500-$237,200): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 20+ years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

Supporting flight test often means contributing during off-nominal hours and weekends.
All candidates are expected to be onsite in Mojave >= 80% of normal work days.
Travel estimated to be approximately 10% or less.
This position is located in Mojave, CA.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Fleet Remediation Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of electrical, mechanical, structural, and hardware engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Fleet Remediation Engineering specializes in retrofit efforts that span several engineering disciplines and is applied across a variety of data center infrastructure designs. We align stakeholders to place a high focus on engineering design quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, and most ambiguous infrastructure retrofit efforts within the existing AWS data center community. By continuously mapping priorities defined via AWS’ Capital Improvement Prioritization Program (CIPP), we invest the proper time and effort into projects that achieve the largest bottom-line impact for the business. We are passionate about ensuring our latest innovations are implemented into our existing fleet to provide maximum benefit on behalf of our customers, and get our energy through challenge, innovation and design.

Requirements

We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to support our data center retrofit programs that modernize and improve our extensive data center fleet. The TPM will lead cross functional and technical teams to drive projects from concept to requirements definition, feasibility assessments, designs, implementation, testing, and deployment. The TPM will develop the strategy for the retrofit of the existing data center fleet with the latest generation of mechanical & electrical products to meet the latest design standards. Additionally, the TPM will lead initiatives associated with the global Fleet Remediation Engineering portfolio, developing or enhancing systems, tools, & mechanisms to streamline project delivery. At Amazon, along with technical strength, we expect our TPMs to interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to understand our joint business goals and priorities, and to execute rapidly, delivering high-quality functionality. The TPM will apply their expertise to:

Develop the path and strategy for incorporation of the latest mechanical & electrical engineering solutions to existing data center fleet.
Lead cross functional and technical teams to drive projects from concept to requirements definition, feasibility assessments, designs, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Evaluate the requirements and actions that enable delivery of the mechanical & electrical programs in our fleet of existing data centers.
Prioritize programs within the portfolio based on technical risks and gain alignment on that prioritization.

At Amazon, along with technical strength, we expect our TPMs to interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to understand our joint business goals and priorities, and to execute rapidly, delivering high-quality functionality.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These capital improvements to our data centers are essential for meeting our customers’ expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon’s goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers to hyper-scale. This role provides a unique opportunity to engage with cloud infrastructure at a large scale and the exceptional people that design and implement solutions and operate the infrastructure for the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical electrical engineering initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments, R&D projects, and understanding of SQL data bases is a plus. A Bachelor's Degree or additional technical experience is required. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, electrical engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

Candidate must be comfortable managing conceptual development efforts, remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project or initiative implementation issues, and remove barriers to project or initiative success. Being able to evaluate project or initiative feasibility, create cross-functional matrix-based teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project or initiative delivery is a must.

The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking.

Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, MS SharePoint and Smartsheet.

A day in the life

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex capital improvement programs and affiliated systems. You prioritize your activities to support and understand the projects’ status, solve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for program success.

About The Team

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience with MS Project, MS Office, and MS Sharepoint

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience with roadmap strategy and definition
Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.title: Senior Customer Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Customer Technical Program Manager to drive the planning and execution of sophisticated, multidisciplinary programs for system level integration and qualification of AI Enterprise Data Center solutions. We expect you to thrive in an agile and forward-thinking environment where we constantly balance between technical complexity, process, quality as well as execution speed. You must have a consistent record on delivering Data Center Platforms level solutions across OEMs with strong planning and technical skills. Those programs will have to accomplish aspects of a business's larger strategy as well specific technical requirement. And, as such, a passion for high-level planning and critical thinking is the cornerstone for this role.

As a member of the Customer Technical Program Management team, you will support a large OEM System Partner from early development phases through coordination of system integration, certification, production readiness for mass production. You will also be required to support the product throughout its lifecycle. These phases include early design through qualification and production readiness. You will be collaborating with multi-functional teams across the company to plan and drive Hardware/Software multi-functional teams. Additionally, assembling requirements, helping prioritization, scheduling, and planning for all phases of the product life cycle. Develop and handle breakthroughs and schedules for the many moving parts that need to come together. Lead and improve existing product development and software release processes; collaborate with engineering management on improving the development workflow and engineering efficiency. You have an opportunity to work well with diverse technical groups, spanning all interpersonal levels.

What You'll Be Doing

Coordinate, plan and execute the NVIDIA Enterprise Products system level integration and requirements into specific tasks and assignments of those tasks to relevant functional areas in coordination with a large OEM System Partner.
Collecting, prioritizing, tracking, and driving customer-reported issues to resolution/closure is a key focus of this role.
Clearly and thoughtfully communicate issue status to the customer and to internal NVIDIA Executive teams.
Work closely with engineering, operations, quality, product management, and sales teams to resolve planning, technical and logistical issues, set correct expectations and keep the scope of the projects on a track to successful execution.
Efficiently coordinate and lead complex technical engineering-to-engineering (hardware and software) discussions.
Properly represent the sense of urgency of issues and raise them (internally and/or externally) as appropriate.
Regularly communicate executive level program report status and key issues to management.
Develop a close working relationship with customer development teams and use creativity to find the best solution. You are a system builder with good solid understanding of assembling and connecting workstation system components such as GPUs, CPUs, memory, networking, and storage systems.

What We Need To See

BS/MS Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
12+ years in High-Tech industry with a focus on Technical Program Management, supporting OEMs/ODMs Enterprise System Partners.
Proven deep customer savvy born of performing complex programs, especially with strategic customers related to Enterprise System Platforms with Tier-1 OEMs.
Technical savvy, including hardware and software engineering, network topologies, network interfaces and system level qualification/deployment requirements.
Supreme leadership skills across broad and diverse functional teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Solid experience in working with large OEMs/ODMs for server system integration, development and deployment with bold timelines and/or constrained resources.
Comfortable defining and driving complex program with intimate understanding of dependencies, critical paths, key and critical landmarks, and results.
Consistent record of handling multiple OEMs/ODMs System Partners and Programs across worldwide geographies and time zones.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 31, 2026.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

National Modernization Project Governance

Provide end‑to‑end project oversight for modernization projects sold nationally but executed across multiple TKE branches.
Serve as the single point of accountability for modernization performance across all Major Mod projects.
Negotiate, maintain, and govern national modernization agreements, supporting branches and local modernization sales teams.
Establish standardized project delivery expectations for scope, schedules, documentation, communication cadence, and escalation protocols across all participating branches.
Partner closely with branch operations, modernization managers, and field project managers to ensure field execution aligns with national commitments and customer expectations.
Maintain real‑time visibility into milestones, risks, delays, and budget impacts; intervene proactively to course‑correct schedules, resources, or customer communication.
Act as the centralized customer communication hub, providing consistent national messaging despite decentralized execution.
Drive regional accountability by monitoring performance trends, correcting systemic issues, and reinforcing standardized delivery models.
Prevent scope drift by ensuring all branches adhere to the contracted national scope, pricing, and commercial terms.
Lead post‑project reviews to capture lessons learned and continuously improve our national modernization delivery model.
Translate execution status and risk into executive‑ready updates for strategic customers and internal leadership.

Financial Performance, Collections, and Profitability Management

Drive profitable modernization performance across all national portfolios through disciplined pricing, accurate scoping, and strict adherence to national terms.
Partner with branches to maintain visibility into job costing, cost‑to‑complete, margin trajectory, and financial variances throughout the project lifecycle.
Own national financial governance for modernization projects, including:
Booked vs. billed monitoring
Margin erosion identification
Cost‑to‑complete tracking
Compliance with national pricing frameworks

Lead the collections strategy for all nationally sold modernization jobs by coordinating with branches, billing teams, and branches to resolve disputes and accelerate AR.
Serve as the escalation point for customer billing concerns, ensuring fast resolution and minimal financial exposure.
Implement margin protection controls, such as change‑order discipline, documentation standards, and financial checkpoint reviews.
Ensure modernization delivery supports organizational revenue, margin, and year‑over‑year growth objectives.

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Business, Engineering or related field.
Minimum 10 years of elevator project management experience and previous managerial experience
Thorough knowledge of elevator equipment and installation methods, and ability to lead installation crews
Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings
Overnight and extended travel is to be expected around 20%
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
Proficiency in MS Project & Excel
Strong layout and submittal preparation skills
Experience in financial forecasting of construction/modernization projects
Experience in detailed contract analysis and negotiation

As a Business Analyst
in the Office of AI, you’ll help turn AI potential into practical outcomes. Location
: Sydney or Melbourne (preferred); flexible across other cities in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

Identify AI use cases aligned to business problems with teams, then shape them into well-defined use cases with clear success measures.
Facilitate discovery, process and transformation workshops, documenting decisions and providing and analysis.
Create clear artefacts, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps that teams can confidently build from acceptance criteria, business rules, and assumptions.
Build value stream maps (current and future state) & define flow measures showing steps, handoffs, decision points, and an improvement backlog to create an evidence base so improvements are visible, defensible, and repeatable.
Support testing, go-live confidence and outcomes tracking by shaping test approach, writing test cases/scenarios, supporting UAT, and validating “definition of done.” Keep outcomes on track through requirements traceability, change management across stakeholders, and value tracking after deployment.
Create transparency and clarity for stakeholders navigating complex change. You’ll partner across the organisation, helping set direction and enabling AI adoption at scale.

About You

Technical

Essential

3–6 years’ experience in business analysis, consulting, or a similar role in complex environments.
Strong capability in gathering requirements, documentation, and stakeholder facilitation.
Demonstrated experience facilitating workshops and translating complex stakeholder inputs into actionable requirements and acceptance criteria.

Highly desirable

Experience delivering process change and transformation, including automation or AI‑enabled initiatives, with hands‑on process mapping and continuous improvement.
Strong grounding in Lean ways of working, including value stream mapping and flow measures (e.g. process vs wait time, rework, handoff quality).
Working knowledge of AI, data, and digital delivery, including core AI concepts (automation, ML, GenAI), data analysis/visualisation tools, and Agile or iterative environments.

Non-Technical

Strong analytical and problem‑solving capability, with the ability to work through complexity and identify practical improvement opportunities.
Clear communication and translation skills, able to turn complex ideas and stakeholder input into structured, understandable outputs.
Confident stakeholder engagement, working effectively across business and technology teams to build alignment and shared understanding.
Skilled workshop facilitation and collaboration, guiding groups to agreed requirements, decisions, and improvement actions.

Personal Attributes

Curiosity and structured thinking; you ask great questions, then turn answers into crisp artefacts.
Integrity and care especially important when shaping solutions that must be trustworthy and responsible.
Comfort with ambiguity

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated capability in business analysis practices: requirements elicitation, documentation, and stakeholder facilitation.

If you’re excited by the idea of mapping real work, cutting through complexity, and helping teams adopt AI in ways that genuinely improve outcomes—this could be your next step.

Maintain data resources and system expertise to execute real world event procedures
Shape confident intel assessments and warn of threats to mission critical space and ground assets; develop new tactics, techniques and procedures TTPs for operations
Lead and/or attend meetings as required; provide space intelligence knowledge as a resource to senior military and civilian government customers

jobs.description:
About The Borough

Joining us, you get to work for not just one high performing London Borough, but two.

Kingston and Sutton councils have a number of shared services serving both authorities, with some teams and roles more focussed on one council than the other, but the majority are shared across both, meaning you get multiple opportunities to learn from a wider pool of activities and two different political bodies.

We work flexibly in both Kingston and Sutton offices, and support working at home or flexible working patterns that enable you to tailor your working and personal life. We provide the equipment and tools to enable you to work flexibly, and in return ask you to use that flexibility to be creative and ambitious in the services we deliver.

There are some really exciting things happening in both boroughs. In Sutton, we are developing the London Cancer Hub, a world leading cancer research and treatment hub that will bring together professionals from across different sectors to identify and test new treatments and therapies. Over in Kingston, we are undertaking the largest housing regeneration programme ever delivered in the borough, building new energy efficient housing that will transform some of our oldest Council owned housing. Both boroughs have publicly committed to doing what they can to tackle the climate emergency and are investing in new technologies and societal change that will help bring carbon emissions down and improve our climate impact.

You should choose Kingston and Sutton if you are looking for an opportunity that will challenge you to deliver more, support you to achieve personal ambitions, and expect you to put borough residents at the heart of what you do.

Kingston is a beautiful Royal borough with a historic setting on the banks of the Thames with excellent schools and a bustling retail centre, all surrounded by open green spaces such as Richmond Park and Bushy Park, former recreation grounds for Tudor Kings and Queens. The Council is controlled by a Liberal Democrat Administration and has a council plan “Greener, Fairer, Safer, Together”, that sets out a vision to be a vibrant, diverse and inclusive borough where residents are active, empowered, engaged and able to remain independent and resilient. The Council engages with residents through a number of forums and events through the year, and like Sutton plays a leading role in developing the South West Region of London.

Sutton is a well connected attractive part of London that has a reputation for excellent schools, green and leafy open spaces, and a history that drives a thriving heritage and culture offer through our museums and libraries. The Council is controlled by a long established Liberal Democrat Administration and has high ambitions set out in its corporate plan “Ambitious for Sutton”, that will ensure Sutton remains a great place to live, work and raise a family. The Council plays a leading role in a number of local partnerships and places great emphasis on engaging effectively with its residents, listening to local voices and making their message heard across London Government.

About The Role And Our Ideal Candidate

In this role, you won't just manage datasets; you will own and deliver the Highways and Transport Data Strategy. Your mission will be to manage, analyse, and visualise transport and highways data to directly shape service delivery, inform strategy, and guide key decision-making across a variety of projects and programmes within both boroughs.

What The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To Do

Own the Highways & Transport Data Strategy by indexing all digital data assets and maintaining accurate GIS mapping layers.
Use SQL and Python to extract and clean large backend datasets, replacing manual extraction with automated dashboards.
Turn dense transport data and traffic surveys into clear, highly visual reports for a variety of audiences.
Upskill internal project managers to build analytical capacity, as well as collaborating with external bodies like Transport for London (TfL) to maximise data opportunities.
Work directly with Highways and Transport project managers to unpack their problems, gather data requirements, and independently run analytical projects from start to finish.

About You

Are you passionate about turning raw data into powerful, strategic insights? Do you want to play a key role in shaping the future of transport across two vibrant London boroughs?

We are seeking a proactive and highly analytical individual who is a quick learner and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy and varied work environment. You are able to explain complex analysis to various audiences to ensure data insights are understood. And are skilled in working with colleagues to understand the problem they are trying to solve and what sources, analysis or data products can help them achieve their goals.

If you’re someone who loves to help colleagues build their own analytical skills, or if you enjoy building partnerships with organisations like Transport for London (TfL), you’ll fit right in. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, happy to take the lead on new projects, and ready to champion a culture of evidence-based thinking.

About Us

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Highways and Transport Programme and Support Team. Operating as a shared service across the Royal Borough of Kingston and the London Borough of Sutton, our team is central to delivering and supporting critical highways services. With the support of the central Council data team, you will act as our lead departmental analyst, driving our transition from being a data-rich service to an information-led service.

Our Offer To You

As an organisation that values and nurtures talent, we’re committed to helping you fulfil your potential and will offer you a supportive, friendly and collaborative environment to grow and develop your career and skills. We’re constantly striving to improve our ways of working so putting your ideas across however big or small; will be fully encouraged and supported by your colleagues and our dynamic and experienced management team.

Benefits

Employees have access to a wide range of benefits to enable staff to achieve a work life balance, some of which include:

A generous annual leave entitlement of 25-32 days, plus bank holidays (pro-rata if part-time working hours apply) depending on service and grade.
Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, shared parental, adoption and dependents leave
Three volunteering days per year in Kingston
Hybrid working (dependent on the role)
Flexible and agile working arrangements using Google Chromebooks
Learning and development portal offering a range of courses
Discounts on a range of local shops, restaurants, gyms and leisure centres
Interest free season ticket loans
Local Government Pension Scheme
Bicycle loan facilities and cycle to work scheme
Electric vehicle leasing scheme
Confidential health & wellbeing and counselling support

Application Process

Apply online outlining what skills, abilities and experience you can bring which makes you an ideal candidate for this role. Please refer to the requirements outlined in the job profile when completing your application and check your CV details have been uploaded correctly in the relevant sections.

We understand and recognise the benefits of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace and are embracing AI where appropriate, to boost our productivity and streamline how we deliver our Council services efficiently; to provide the best possible outcomes for our residents and communities.

However, we reserve the right to reject applications where it is apparent that AI-generated content has been used in isolation and without personalised responses. At Kingston we value authenticity and are looking for individuals who can clearly demonstrate their own skills, experience and motivation for the role that they are applying for and embrace and demonstrate our STAR values.

Here at Kingston we have core values of Transparency and this is to be demonstrated during the application process and completion of the supporting statement and will be further tested at interview and selection stage for those who progress forward.

The closing date is given as a guide. We reserve the right to close this vacancy once a sufficient number of applications has been received, it is strongly advised that you complete and submit your application as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

As part of our award winning Diversity Programme we anonymise all applications received to reduce conscious and unconscious bias enabling every application to be reviewed on the knowledge, skills and experience shown in your application. We encourage our interview panels to be as diverse as possible (age, cultural, neurodiverse etc.) to reduce bias where possible. We are fully committed to removing barriers and enhancing the diversity of our workforce.

Additional Information

We are proud to be a diverse and welcoming Borough and we strive to create a workforce which reflects the community we serve, and instil a sense of belonging in our staff. We celebrate and respect differences and appreciate the value of having a diverse workforce, therefore we welcome applications from under represented groups.

To support our workers and their families we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and inclusive staff networks who help drive our diversity agenda.

We are also proud to be a disability confident employer and guarantee to interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum essential criteria for a role. As an accredited London Living Wage Employer all our employees are guaranteed the London Living Wage regardless of their length or type of contract.

The UK has a points-based immigration system affecting EU and Non-EU workers and sponsorship requirements. We advise checking the GOV.UK website for right to work guidance. Sponsorship availability varies and is subject to eligibility requirements and budget limitations. As a result, we cannot guarantee sponsorship for all roles and will evaluate sponsorship requests on a case-by-case basis.

Patient Safety/Grievance Program Manager - TH Urgent Care (Breeze), Full-time, Days

Bring your passion to Texas Health so we are Better + Together

Work location: Position is primarily remote and will attend quarterly meetings at System Services - 612 E Lamar, Arlington, TX 76011

Work hours: Full-time, Exempt position, 40 hours/week, Monday-Friday, 8 am – 4pm; Position is remote but local to DFW area (THR service area)

Department Highlights

Collaborative, self-directed team focused on results, excellence, and hard work
Pride in delivering meaningful work—and in the satisfaction of shared success
Strengths intentionally optimized and leveraged
Growth and development actively supported
Culture of accountability built on trust

Here’s What You Need

Bachelor's Degree Nursing preferred or other related clinical profession required
Master's Degree in related Field preferred
5-years progressive experience in clinical healthcare with the most recent experience being at least 3 years in healthcare risk management, patient safety, grievance coordination and/or quality program management with proven experience leading inter-professional teams with deployment of effective and reliable processes required
3-years’ experience in High Reliability Organization (HRO) principles and leadership preferred
RN - Registered Nurse RN - Registered Nurse Upon Hire required Or
Other Clinical Healthcare Related Field Upon Hire required
CRM - Certified Risk Manager within 12 Months required Or
CPPS - Certified Professional in Patient Safety within 12 Months required Or
CPHRM - Certified Professional in Healthcare Risk Management within 12 Months required Or
ARM - Associate in Risk Management within 12 Months required

What You Will Do

This position will contribute and coordinate Patient Safety, Risk Management programs and Grievance Coordination necessary to achieve THR's strategic goal of becoming a High Reliability Organization (HRO) through leading HRO implementation and sustainability activities. Responsibilities will include the support of each wholly owned entity on a day-to-day basis through program ownership or coordination, investigating, analyzing and trending patient safety events and data, complaints and grievances and data, conducting patient safety and risk management educational programs, complying with licensing, accrediting and regulatory obligations with the objectives of enhancing patient, visitor and employee safety; promoting quality care; and protecting the assets of the organization.

Support THUC patient safety, risk management programs and grievance coordination strategies. Provide support and guidance to the THUC personnel and acts as a resource to leaders and staff for patient safety event investigation, complaints/ grievances management, relevant regulatory compliance, high reliability, and all identified potentially compensable events (consumers and product).
Investigate, evaluate, and analyze events that threaten or potentially threaten patient safety through the following: review of medical records, identification and interview of staff, collection of data and/or creating timelines, review of related literature, review of applicable policies and review of event reporting. Demonstrates knowledge and competency of maintaining event reporting system and review, investigation, and evaluation of harm events and feedback events per defined methodology, process and policy.
Lead efforts to increase organizational understanding of patient safety and risk management initiatives, complaints and grievances and high reliability principles through dedicated educational programs for staff. Programs may be at the THUC or coordinated through THRU.
Actively participate in and provide support for patient safety, complaint and grievance trends and quality initiatives including event investigation, event classification and cause analysis.
Facilitate and/or participate with various task forces, committees and ad-hoc committees both at the system, and THUC level to implement identified patient safety and clinical risk and complaint/ grievance initiatives as needed with on-going monitoring and involvement to ensure continued progress. Coordinate the selection, presentation and follow-up of cases to assigned Committees.
Supports development and implementation of preventive risk management programs. Serves as a resource for efforts with education and training staff in appropriate procedures, documentation, reporting, and follow-up in key areas of risk management and complaints/ grievances.
Acts as the organizations expert resource in risk reduction and keeps abreast of trends in the industry. Responsible for ensuring the organization is compliant with new and revised national, state, and local healthcare risk-patient safety and complaints/ grievances associated THR policy, laws, statutes, community standards and laws.
Serves as a support for patient complaint/ grievance management to align with THR processes for patient and consumer complaint management workflow and reporting. jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS offers over 100 fully featured services to millions of active customers around the world—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their infrastructure.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

The AWS RI Operations Team is in need of a driven, analytical, and process-oriented individual to own the creation and processing of Reservation Product transaction requests. We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is excited to escalate systemic issues, identify opportunities for improvement, has experience meeting strict SLAs, is comfortable working from a ticket queue, and has a passion for accuracy.

Key job responsibilities

Process and audit Reservation Product transactions such as: cancellations, purchases, migrations, and modifications while adhering to Legal, Security, and Compliance requirements
Occasionally act as escalation point for Reservation Product requests and issues
Investigate data discrepancies, quickly establish root causes, and propose appropriate solutions
Vocally self-critical to allow for self-correction of errors
Communicate effectively across all related channels to ensure transparency of process

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Accounting, or a related field
2+ years experience in business analysis and functional roles requiring quantitative, analytical and organizational skills, including intermediate Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLookups)
Experience with Microsoft Excel including the ability to create pivot tables and charts, develop formulas such as SUMIF, and use VLookup formulas

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with a queue of requests with Service Level Agreements (SLA) and accuracy targets against Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
Experience navigating a knowledge base and following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Experience performing data analysis and troubleshooting data integrity issues
Occasionally retrieve and evaluate data using Excel and other data management/BI systems

Process reservation transactions — Work through a ticket queue to action cancellations, purchases, migrations, and modifications of Reserved Instance products, ensuring each request meets Legal, Security, and Compliance requirements within strict SLAs.
Investigate and resolve data discrepancies — Identify root causes of transaction errors or mismatches, propose solutions, and self-audit work to maintain accuracy across all processed requests.
Escalate systemic issues and drive improvements — Flag recurring patterns or process gaps to leadership, and recommend operational improvements that reduce manual effort or prevent future errors.
Communicate and collaborate across channels — Provide transparent status updates on in-flight requests, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and occasionally retrieve and evaluate data in Excel or BI tools to support decision-making.

Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with ability to identify trends, develop data-driven solutions, and comfort with AI-assisted analytics tools.

Interface with various levels across various departments within the company.

Participate in the monthly close cycle, ensuring all cutoffs and deadlines are met and that the monthly results are accurate.
