Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
Understand and follow company rules and regulations.
Perform all other duties as assigned and required.

Proficiency in MS Office - particularly advanced Excel functionality (e.g., pivot tables, LOOKUP formulas)

Define and track program health metrics such as model quality, training speed, evaluation coverage, and time‑to‑release, and share clear status, risks, and decisions in executive reviews.
We work as one team, we solve hard problems together, and we celebrate when complex programs ship and make a difference for customers.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
15+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or data/ML delivery, including significant time in ML/AI or large‑scale data environments.
Experience leading complex, multi‑stakeholder programs end to end in research and engineering organizations, with evolving requirements and clear delivery timelines.
Comfort working with ML researchers, interpreting model and evaluation results, and making decisions about training pipelines, data, and infrastructure trade‑offs.

Delivering graph ML, recommender, or fraud‑detection systems into production, or shipping ML platforms and frameworks that other teams build on.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

Ensemble Health Partners is standing up a Product Program Management function, and we're hiring the first members of the team. Our technology and innovation/product organization runs on an initiative/pod structure. Cross-functional teams move products through a defined Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) with maturity gates and a regular planning cadence. Our Product Operations team owns the tools and processes behind that system. Senior
Product Program Managers
are embedded with product teams and apply those standards consistently, so we can ship strong products that improve revenue cycle operations for focus areas within the Patient, Payer, and Provider domains.

What You'll Do

Each Product Program Manager
covers 2 to 3 pods or initiative areas, working directly with the Product Leads in those areas. Your job is to keep their programs moving: shipping on cadence, surfacing risks early, and creating additional connectivity across product, engineering, and rev cycle operations.

Day to day, that means:

Guiding your programs through the PDLC and its gates, with the appropriate standards and rigor applied. You make sure requirements are documented, entry and exit criteria are met and gate reviews are prepared, well-run, and end in a decision.
Running the planning and delivery rhythm for your pods, including planning cycles and the recurring meetings that keep teams aligned. Meetings you run should produce decisions, not just updates.
Identifying risks, dependencies, and blockers before they become problems, then either resolving them yourself or escalating with options and a recommendation.
Supporting the business needs of your programs: budget and forecast support, vendor coordination, value realization visibility, resource visibility, and status reporting to executive leadership.
Working within our established processes and tooling, and holding your programs to them. Consistent process is what makes delivery predictable and lets leadership compare programs across the portfolio.
Uses enterprise AI tools (Claude, Copilot, etc.) as a default part of daily work to accelerate analysis, drafting, and program reporting.
Helping build the function itself. The playbooks, templates, and norms for Product Program Management at Ensemble don't fully exist yet. You'll help write them based on what you learn in your pods and value streams.

How You'll Work

You'll work most closely with a few groups:

Product & Innovation Leaders are your primary partners. They own product strategy, priorities, and value definition. You own execution & rigor: the path from decision to delivery. When this partnership works, Product Leads see you as someone they can't run their program without.
Product Operations designs the processes, tools, and standards your programs run on. You're their feedback loop. You apply what they build, tell them what's working and what isn't, and help improve the operating model each cycle.
Engineering builds and ships the work. Sprint execution stays with Engineering, but you coordinate everything that surrounds them: readiness going in, outcomes and issues coming out, and the cross-team dependencies in between. Engineering should experience you as the person who keeps their runway clear.

What You Bring

Required:

7-10 years of prior experience in product program management or product-oriented project management. You've driven software or technology products through a development lifecycle, not just managed generic projects.
Fluency navigating a structured PDLC: gate criteria, phase transitions, and what a healthy program looks like at each stage.
A track record of coordinating cross-functional teams (product, engineering, design, operations, business stakeholders) without direct authority over them.
Executive status reporting
Good judgment about when to push, when to escalate, and how to communicate with senior leadership.
Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.
This position pays between $101,600-152,400 based on experience

Preferred:

Healthcare, revenue cycle management (RCM) experience
Familiarity with product and delivery tooling such as Aha!, monday.com, or Azure DevOps.
Experience working in an agile or similar scaled planning cadence.
Prior involvement in standing up or maturing a PMO, program management, or product operations function.

Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include:

jobs.description:
How You Will Make An Impact

We are looking for a commercially driven, partnership-focused individual to join our growing Comparison team. You will take ownership of our client and partner relationships, lead channel performance analysis, and drive the development of new comparison partnerships — all in service of our major UK comparison clients including Go.Compare and Confused.com.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial trading, relationship management, and product optimisation. You will be responsible for ensuring our comparison services run accurately and efficiently, reflecting the most up-to-date pricing and products in the market — ideally ahead of our competitors. You will use data to drive decisions, build strong partnerships, and contribute directly to the growth and performance of our comparison channels.

Please note: Our comparison services operate within UK insurance markets regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). You will be expected to work within relevant regulatory guidelines and contribute to a culture of compliance and Treating Customers Fairly (TCF).

Primary Responsibilities

Client & Partner Relationship Management

Own day-to-day management of comparison client relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for major UK partners including Go.Compare and Confused.com.
Manage day-to-day relationships with comparison insurance partners, ensuring smooth communication, accurate product representation, and timely delivery of changes.
Lead the development and onboarding of new comparison partnerships, from scoping through to live delivery.

Channel Performance & Commercial Analysis

Lead channel trade analysis and performance reporting, translating data into clear, actionable insights for internal and external stakeholders.
Conduct partner-level performance analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across the comparison channel.
Monitor competitor activity and market developments, providing regular insights to inform product and commercial strategy.
Track and report on consumer trends, contributing to product and positioning decisions that keep our services relevant and competitive.

Product & Channel Optimisation

Lead on product optimisation initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve channel performance and customer experience.
Scope and coordinate delivery of all channel changes and partner onboarding activity, working closely with internal product and development teams.
Ensure comparison services reflect the most current and accurate products and pricing in the market at all times.

Compliance & Governance

Work within FCA regulatory requirements applicable to UK insurance comparison, including adherence to Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) principles.
Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with internal governance and audit requirements.

Essential

Knowledge & Skill:

Proven background in comparison, online marketplace, or a related digital/commercial environment.
Commercially astute, with a track record of driving value through data insight and channel performance analysis.
Experienced in partnership or client relationship management, with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
Strong analytical mindset — confident working with data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
Understanding of why consumers and providers use price comparison services, and what drives channel performance.
Methodical and process-driven, with excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
A self-starter who takes initiative and follows through with minimal supervision.
Exceptional attention to detail — you take accuracy seriously and hold yourself and others to a high standard.

Desirable

Direct experience working with major UK aggregators (e.g. Go.Compare, Confused.com, CompareTheMarket).
Exposure to FCA-regulated insurance products or financial services environments.
Experience leading or contributing to new partnership development and onboarding.
Familiarity with the pet insurance or device/electronics insurance market.

Tools & Education

Required

Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint (or Google equivalents) — you use these tools confidently for analysis, reporting, and stakeholder presentations.
Comfortable working with online product databases and data portals.

Desirable

Experience with CRM, project management, or ticketing tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Salesforce).
Familiarity with data visualisation or BI tools.

Education:
No specific degree required. We value commercial acumen, analytical capability, and proven partnership management experience over formal qualifications.

About Us

Opensignal is the leading global provider of independent insight and data into network experience and market performance. Our user-centric approach allows communication providers to constantly improve their network and maximise commercial performance. Leading analysts, investors and financial institutions place a high value on our independent analysis and we are regular contributors to their reports.

Real network experience is our focus and ultimately that's what influences customer choice. Our mission is to advance connectivity for all and here at Opensignal, the team is leading the industry in enabling operators to link their network experience and market performance in a way that has never before been possible.

With offices in London, Boston, Victoria, British Columbia, and Warsaw, and employees around the world, we are a truly global organization. We are an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.

Benefits

We believe we are stronger when we not only celebrate our many differences, values, and voices but also include them in everyday practice. Having a diverse and inclusive culture is essential, which is why we offer a flexible approach to work-life balance, operating in a remote-hybrid way. Competitive compensation packages; including a long-term equity program.

Who We Are

Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.

About The Team

The Agent Deployment
team is a customer-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise-grade features and products. Deployment Strategists, Renewals own each customer's long-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go-live.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, Renewals on Serval's Agent Deployment team, you'll be the long-term owner of customer outcomes, making sure the value created at deployment compounds into adoption, expansion, and renewal. You're the customer's primary technical partner post-deployment: resolving issues, deepening their use of Serval, and advocating for their needs internally.

What sets this role apart is that you don't just manage success, you build it. You'll write code, ship fixes, and create the systems and automation that let us deliver world-class support to more customers without scaling headcount in lockstep. This role is for someone who blends real technical depth with customer obsession and a commercial instinct for what drives retention and growth.

The best Deployment Strategist, Renewals leave every customer more self-sufficient, and every process more scalable, than they found it, so that the success of the next ten customers is easier than the last.

What You’ll Do

Own deployment production success and support: serve as the primary technical resource post-sale, troubleshooting issues, resolving them quickly, and advocating for customer needs internally.
Drive renewals and expansion: turn strong adoption into renewals, and surface opportunities to deepen and expand Serval's footprint within each account.
Build systems that scale support: create the tooling, automation, and playbooks that let the team support more customers without scaling headcount linearly.
Ship product changes: modify production code to fix bugs and build features that extend Serval's capabilities to meet customer needs.
Make customers self-sufficient: run training sessions and create documentation that help customers get full value from Serval on their own.

What You’ll Need

Startup experience in a customer-facing or technical role.
Strong technical foundation, including the ability to read and troubleshoot production code in customer-facing environments: analyzing code paths, database state, and API requests/responses with infra and browser dev tools.
An eagerness to build, writing code and automation to create scalable systems rather than one-off fixes.

Nice to Have

Experience in an early-stage startup environment.

Experience owning renewals or commercial relationships.

Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills.

Job Description

Parsons is seeking passionate, skilled, and experienced professionals to join a major program and construction management team that is dedicated to supporting a large Department of War customer in the Las Vegas area to successfully deliver a significant new beddown program.

In our anticipated role, Parsons will provide Owner’s Advisor Construction Management Services including Program Management, Design Management, Construction Management, Risk Management, Scheduling, Cost Estimating, Progress Reporting, Construction Quality Assurance, Safety, and other supporting services to achieve program success .

The Deputy Program Manager for Technical Services (DPM-TS) serves as the senior technical leader under the Parsons Program Director. In this role, you will lead all technical services and program controls supporting functions during Owner’s Advisor Construction Management activities for a large, complex, secure federal facility. You will be responsible for requirements management, technical integration, specialty mission systems support, and program controls across planning, design, construction, commissioning, and turnover phases, ensuring alignment with mission needs, cost, schedule, quality, and security objectives.

The DPM-TS will oversee and provide technical leadership over the following functions during project execution:

Requirements Development
Program Controls
Specialty and Technical Support
Technical Inspection
Design Reviews
Requirements Management
Value Engineering
Technical Standards Application
Security/Accreditation Support
ICD 705 / RF Support
Commissioning Services

The DPM-TS will oversee and provide technical leadership over the following functions during project execution:

Requirements Development
Program Controls
Specialty and Technical Support
Technical Inspection
Design Reviews
Requirements Management
Value Engineering
Technical Standards Application
Security/Accreditation Support
ICD 705 / HEMP / RF Support
C4IT Inspection
Commissioning Services

What You'll Be Doing

Provide day-to-day leadership for all Technical Services and Program Controls activities in support of the Parsons Program Director for the project.
Translate program objectives, mission requirements, and stakeholder direction into actionable technical, schedule, and cost baselines and execution strategies.
Advise the Program Director and Client on technical and contractual issues impacting requirements, design, constructability, mission systems integration, and facility performance.
Lead development and implementation of technical aspects of key performance indicators (KPIs), including safety, quality, schedule, and financial metrics, ensuring clear upward reporting to the client.

Technical Leadership Services

Establish process for technical reviews of design submittals at all stages to verify alignment with client mission needs, UFC/DoD criteria, anti-terrorism/force protection, and applicable codes and standards.
Implement and manage a rigorous requirements management process to capture, trace, and validate functional, technical, security, and performance requirements from planning through commissioning.
Direct value engineering (VE) studies to optimize life-cycle cost, performance, maintainability, and resilience while maintaining mission-critical capabilities and security requirements.
Ensure consistent application of technical standards, including Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, and Service-specific criteria for secure facilities, specialized infrastructure, and IT-intensive environments.
Identify design and construction risks related to requirements definition, scope gaps, standards interpretation, and changes, and develop mitigation strategies.

Program Controls

Direct the Program Controls Manager and team in developing and maintaining the Integrated Master Schedule, integrating government, designer, construction, and commissioning activities to reflect critical path and key milestones.
Oversee development, review, and validation of cost estimates, budget forecasts, and GMP-related analysis in support of the Owner’s Agent, including change order and claim evaluations.
Direct comprehensive risk management across technical, cost, schedule, and contract execution domains; identify risk drivers, develop mitigation and contingency strategies, and report risk status and exposure.
Implement robust financial tracking, auditing, and performance analysis processes to support accurate cost reporting, trend analysis, and early identification of issues affecting program affordability.
Support preparation of clear, accurate progress reports to management and the client, including status of milestones, risk, cost and schedule performance metrics, and forecast outcomes. Specialty Support
Lead specialty technical support for secure facility planning, design, construction, and accreditation, coordinating closely with Government security and accreditation authorities.
Oversee compliance with ICD 705 and other applicable secure facility standards, with specific focus on related protective measures required for mission resilience.
Direct technical integration of IT, including communications infrastructure, networking, mission systems, and supporting facilities, ensuring proper coordination between building systems, IT, and operational users.
Ensure that design, construction, and commissioning incorporate lifecycle sustainment considerations, including reliability, maintainability, upgrade paths, and total ownership cost.
Coordinate specialty consultants, test and evaluation activities, and interface control to ensure mission systems and protective features are properly integrated and validated.
Manage the Technical Inspection efforts to provide field engineering support to verify construction quality, conformance with design and technical criteria, and resolution of field issues.
Oversee inspection and verification of shielding and CPS installations, coordinating with specialty testers and ensuring documentation supports accreditation and mission readiness.
Direct inspection and integration checks for IT infrastructure and systems during installation and testing, ensuring compatibility with facility infrastructure and mission requirements.
Manage and coordinate commissioning services across building systems, mission-critical systems, and specialty infrastructure, ensuring performance, redundancy, and resiliency requirements are met.

Monitor and report progress of all technical and controls-related activities, highlighting significant milestones and conditions affecting cost, schedule, security, technical performance, or accreditation.

Active Secret clearance; ability to maintain required clearance throughout employment.
15+ years of broad and diversified experience on relevant design, requirements development, and technical support on large, complex capital projects or programs, preferably involving secure or mission-critical facilities.
Experience on major new construction projects with constructed value over ; experience above preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in construction management practices, including design oversight, technical reviews, field engineering, and commissioning.
Proven leadership in managing multidisciplinary technical and controls teams on complex assignments, including subordinate managers and specialized technical branches.
Strong capability in risk identification and mitigation for large construction programs, including understanding of technical, schedule, cost, and contract risks.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce clear, accurate, and actionable reports and briefings for senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager, Devices
jobs.description:
About Atomic Machines:

Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital, but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi-process, multi-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device, made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform, addressing a critical need in the rapidly evolving AI data center world, and we are commercializing it now.

Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Program Manager to own the program for that first device's successor, end to end: from requirements still maturing with lead customers, through qualification, certification, and manufacturing scale-up on the Matter Compiler, to commercial launch. That successor is a new class of micromachine, made possible only by the Matter Compiler, and you will be the leader that delivers it.

At Atomic Machines, Program Management is a leverage function, and its core skill is clarity. The Device program's technical leadership is already in place: device design, process, test, and reliability are each led by deep domain owners who move fast and expect the same. You lead that team as one program, and you drive the outcome, integrated plan, customer commitments, tradeoffs, operating cadence, and decisions that keep every discipline moving as one. Technical direction belongs to the domain owners; turning their work into the outcomes of certified, scaling, revenue-generating products belongs to you. This role is for someone who was an individual contributor in complex technical domains and moved into program leadership on purpose: to influence product direction, align engineering and manufacturing, and own outcomes end to end.

What You'll Do:

Develop and drive the program roadmap end to end: set goals, define milestones and evidence gates, and build the accountability structure that connects daily engineering work to business outcomes and customer commitments.
Direct cross-functional execution across device physics, fabrication processes, automation, and system integration: set the deliverables, sequencing, and resource calls for engineering, operations, and leadership.
Build and run the integrated plan connecting customer commitments, design maturity, process capability, and manufacturing readiness. Run the operating cadence that keeps it honest.
Turn maturing customer requirements into committed, testable targets, and hold the program to them.
Build the program structures that keep device and process development in lockstep with the Matter Compiler platform. Move development from R&D into production and define what each handoff must prove.
Structure the program around evidence and short learning loops: design the build-test-learn iteration cycles, give every open unknown an experiment with a pass/fail criterion, and let the schedule follow from results.
Own the qualification and certification path (e.g., UL/IEC) as a program commitment shaped into the design from day one.
Deliver the outcome: the device demonstrated, evaluated by lead customers, and qualified through production ramp.
Institutionalize what you learn: build the systems, rhythms, and decision structures the whole organization runs on, so the next program moves faster than this one.

What You'll Need:

8+ years spanning hands-on engineering and technical program leadership on complex multidisciplinary hardware: you have personally taken things from thought to build and owned programs that others depended on.
A track record of taking integrated hardware systems from concept through manufacturing release and commercial delivery, with the judgment to know when a decision needs more rigor and when to move fast.
Deep technical fluency in at least one core engineering domain and productive command across the rest: you hold your own with engineers designing in coupled physical domains — electromagnetics, structural mechanics, thermal behavior, fluidics, and materials.
You drive senior technical leads to deliver at a high level: clarity, structure, and pace, while technical direction stays with the domain owner.
Relentlessness in driving through ambiguity: turning unresolved requirements into scope, evidence gates, and a plan the team runs.
Conviction in iterative hardware development and short learning loops — build early, test early, learn fast, continually finding the shortest learning loop.
True Ownership of your program and domain, with bottom-line-up-front communication, trusted by engineers and leadership alike. The strongest people you've worked with would choose to work with you again.
BS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Materials Science.

Nice to Have:

Reliability engineering for microscale or precision devices: accelerated life testing, environmental stress testing, and long-term performance characterization.
Experience driving a product through UL, IEC, or equivalent certification.
Experience standing up programs from ground zero, then driving reliability growth to manufacturing scale.

The company is building a modern GPU cloud platform for AI and high-performance compute workloads. Customers choose this organization when they need high-performance infrastructure with more flexibility, visibility, and support than they get from traditional options. About the Role

The company is looking for a business operations manager to help turn a fast-moving organization into a more effective, scalable one.

This role will work across the business on the operating rhythms, planning processes, and cross-functional coordination that help teams move faster with better judgment. That means building clarity where things are messy, creating structure where structure is missing, and helping leadership make decisions with a stronger grasp of tradeoffs, priorities, and execution risk.

This is a highly leveraged role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and execution. On any given week, this individual might be building a planning model, improving an internal process, driving a cross-functional initiative, preparing materials for an important decision, or helping close gaps between commercial, product, infrastructure, and finance priorities.

In the first 8-12 months, the successful candidate will have improved the company’s operating cadence, brought more structure to planning and prioritization, made key cross-functional work easier to execute, and helped leadership spend less time chasing information and more time making good decisions.

Bring leverage through AI and automation. Use AI tools and lightweight automation to reduce manual work, improve workflows, and increase team productivity

Strong business judgment and the ability to break ambiguous problems into clear, actionable work

Strong quantitative skills and comfort building models, tracking metrics, and synthesizing operational data
Excellent written and verbal communication, especially when aligning stakeholders with different priorities
High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture

What's the Short Version?

The Data Analyst, MH&P works directly with stakeholders in Distribution, IT, and other SanMar business areas to provide subject matter expertise in the flow and transformation of data through warehouse processes. This role develops a deep understanding of data inputs, transformations, and outputs and effectively communicates those data paths at both individual and aggregate levels to support strategic and tactical decision-making. As a member of the Distribution Systems and Processes (MHaP) team, the Data Analyst is responsible for the analysis, configuration, administration, and support of distribution-facing systems and processes. This includes supporting Körber WMS and related SQL databases, Pick/Pack/Ship services, Labor Management Systems (LMS), slotting, reporting, and dashboard solutions that enable scalable, reliable, and efficient distribution operations.

What Will You Be Doing?

Acquire data from primary and secondary sources, validate data integrity, filter corrupt records, and prepare clean, structured datasets for analysis and reporting.
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies in complex datasets while using descriptive and predictive analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations using business intelligence tools that make complex data accessible and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
Provide business intelligence and reporting to Distribution stakeholders to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports in response to business needs.
Partner with MHaP analysts, process teams, and engineers to provide data supporting continuous improvement initiatives and report on actual results, ROI, and ROPI.
Collaborate with IT and Distribution stakeholders on the design, support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of business tools and systems.
Configure and maintain WMS and related system data, including site configuration and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support.
Oversee LMS administration and data recertification as required.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
1-3 years experience in data analysis, supply chain or warehouse logistics analysis preferred
Solid knowledge of technology-based distribution systems and tools, with experience in SanMar systems preferred; such as HighJump/Körber WMS, SQL databases and reporting tools, Exacta WCS, Easy Metrics, and AutoStore
Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to effectively analyze and present information effectively to stakeholders
Strong data visualization, reporting, and data storytelling skills
Ability to build collaborative relationships across all levels of the organization and vendor partners.
Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills; ability to learn quickly and resolve issues self-sufficiently
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
Excellent prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational skills with an appropriate sense of urgency
Experience with statistical analysis experience preferred
Lean Six Sigma experience preferred
Flexible with schedule, able to provide off-hours support either remotely, or onsite, as needed
Ability to travel infrequently as needed to support SanMar distribution network (up to 10%) preferred

What's Our Offer?

Salary Range: You`ll earn between $80,170 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience.

Bonus: You`ll be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus up to 10% of base salary.

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a bi-weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle
Life insurance
Short/long-term disability coverage
Paid maternity/paternity leave
Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

Remote: Our standard working hours are 8:00-5:00 PST. Periodic travel may be required. The employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods while working on a computer and participating in virtual and in-person meetings. Frequent use of hands for keyboarding and standard office equipment is required. Occasional standing, walking, and reaching may be needed to attend meetings or collaborate in an office setting. The role requires the ability to perform close visual work on a computer for extended periods. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10–15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Why Work at SanMar?

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. They bring their talent, passion and dedication to work with them every day. Their hard work inspires us and gives us purpose. We love working here together.

Whether you work in our headquarters, from your home or in one of our distribution centers across North America, we believe that investing in you is just the right thing to do. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and well-being, life balance, career growth and (eventually) retirement.

SanMar works with brands you already know, like Nike, The North Face and Brooks Brothers, as well as providing industry-leading private label apparel and accessories. Our people come to work excited to do their part, providing clothing that helps people feel that they’re a part of something special.

Here’s your chance to be a part of this story. If you’re ready to work in a place where your participation matters and your growth is a priority, we’re ready for you.

SanMar is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, whoever you love or follow in faith, whatever your disability or superpower status, whichever ethnicity or gender you identify with, you are welcome at SanMar.

SanMar participates in E-Verify.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

UCI Health is one of California's largest academic health systems and the clinical enterprise of the University of California, Irvine. Established on July 1, 1976, UCI Health has grown into a 1,461-bed health system that includes UCI Health - Orange, UCI Health - Irvine, four Community Network hospitals and a growing network of ambulatory care centers across Orange and Los Angeles counties.

As Orange County’s only academic health systems, UCI Health is home to the only National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center based in the county, the region’s only American College of Surgeons-verified Level I adult and Level II pediatric trauma center, American College of Emergency Physicians Gold Level 1 Geriatric Emergency Department and a nationally recognized regional burn center verified by the American Burn Association. Powered by UC Irvine, UCI Health serves 5.6 million people across Orange County, western Riverside County and southeast Los Angeles County through excellence in patient care, research and medical education.

Your Role on the Team

Position Summary

As a recognized organization-wide expert and influential, trusted partner, the incumbent will have a significant contribution on the success of UCI Health's integrated clinical financial planning, reporting, and financial operations initiatives. Utilizing comprehensive knowledge, this position optimizes financial and operational excellence by leading enterprise business and capital implementation and integration, enterprise financial planning, and finance and business applications efforts. The incumbent supports strategic performance management programs that deliver sustainable, measurable changes across UCI Health. This position builds and integrates financial projection analyses aligned with strategic initiatives and develops strategy and methods for providing financial management and planning information to senior executives, managers, and clinicians. The incumbent leverages data systems to build a robust fact base, quantify financial and operational benefits, and prioritize efforts.

Required Qualifications

What It Takes to be Successful

Strong presentation skills and the ability to translate complex data into executive presentations
Solid understanding of financial modeling and forecasting techniques with demonstrated ability to build robust models to accurately forecast future performance, develop assumptions, and provide insights supporting strategic planning and objectives
Proficient in the ability to develop, analyze, and interpret application of data from multiple sources
Must possess the skill, knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Must be results-driven to drive quantifiable results
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a health system-based environment working with decision support systems or relevant financial and operational analysis experience
Minimum 2 years’ experience in an academic healthcare setting managing funds flow supporting the faculty practice and clinical operations
Internal or external financial consulting (or equivalent experience)
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office software
Highly developed problem solving, analytical ability, critical thinking, and problem solving skills
Highly advanced organizational and project management skills
Expert understanding of business planning including analysis, relational databases, statistics, data modeling, budgeting, feasibility studies, financial pro forma, return analysis, and implementation
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Effective communicator able to understand the needs of a variety of audience members and tailor a message accordingly
Demonstrated ability to lead a team, prioritize tasks, and see projects through from inception to completion on schedule
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field
Advanced ability to present complex finance-related information verbally and in writing in a clear, concise manner
Ability to plan, set expectations (for self and others), and accomplish multiple objectives within specific timeframes.
Ability to manage risk and ambiguity on a project
Ability to maintain an organized approach, clarity of purpose, and goal orientation in a rapidly changing environment involving multiple stakeholders of various levels from throughout the organization.
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
10 years of financial reporting and analysis experience

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field
Knowledge of healthcare market, government rules and regulations
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies and procedures
Knowledge of Strata or other similar hospital budgeting and cost accounting systems
Knowledge of Action OI and other benchmarking platforms

Total Rewards

We offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. new_jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Minerra Health is an integrated metabolic-care platform that unifies behavioral, medical, and surgical care pathways through an intelligent system powered by MIRA and MIND. Using AI-driven guidance, human coaching, and clinical support, Minerra Health delivers personalized engagement, real-time insights, and continuous learning across the full care journey. The organization partners with employers, health systems, payers, and TPAs to improve outcomes, lower costs, and expand access to evidence-based obesity care for diverse populations. With specialties in metabolic and obesity care, AI-driven navigation, clinical intelligence, digital care engagement, and population health, Minerra Health focuses on measurable impact in smarter metabolic care.
Role Description
The Operations Project Manager is a remote role responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing cross-functional projects that support the operations and client success of Minerra Health’s integrated metabolic-care platform. This role oversees project timelines, tasks, and deliverables, ensuring operational processes are efficient, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing project plans, tracking milestones, managing risks and issues, and coordinating with clinical, technical, and business teams to maintain clear communication and accountability. The Operations Project Manager will also monitor operational performance metrics and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, delivery and client satisfaction.
Working Hours:
Primarily U.S. business hours with limited India-hours overlap as required
Compensation:
Commensurate with experience and capabilities
Reports To:
Vice President, Operations & Client Success
The Role Minerra Health is seeking a highly organized, persistent, and execution-oriented Operations Project Manager
based in India to support our U.S. operations and client success, as well as cross-functional product, clinical, and implementation activities.
This is not a role for someone who simply schedules meetings, takes notes, and updates project plans.
We need someone who drives work forward
.
A major responsibility of this position is maintaining visibility into commitments across Minerra Health and our clients, identifying what needs to happen next, following up relentlessly but professionally, and ensuring critical operational and client-support activities do not stall.
You will work closely with the Vice President of Operations & Client Success and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Data/Analytics, Marketing, Sales, and client teams in some aspect.
You should be comfortable asking:
What is the next action? Who owns it? When is it due? What is blocking it? What needs to happen to get it completed?

Then you should stay with the issue until it is resolved.
The right person is resourceful, highly dependable, comfortable operating across time zones, and motivated by getting things done.

What You'll Do1. Project & Program Management Manage multiple operational, implementation, and client initiatives simultaneously.
Responsibilities include:
Build and maintain project plans, workplans, milestones, dependencies, and timelines.
Translate meetings, discovery sessions, and leadership discussions into specific tasks and deliverables.
Assign and track owners, deadlines, dependencies, and completion status.
Maintain Jira projects, tickets and related documentation.
Keep Confluence project documentation organized, current, and usable.
Maintain action-item trackers and decision logs.
Monitor scope, timelines, deliverables, and risks.
Identify projects or tasks that are beginning to slip before deadlines are missed.
Escalate blockers with clear recommendations for resolution.
Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Data, Marketing, and Client Success.
Support implementation plans for new clients, products, workflows, and operational programs.
Maintain visibility across multiple projects without losing important details.

You should be comfortable taking a loosely structured initiative and turning it into an organized execution plan.
2. Action-Item Ownership & Follow-Through This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.
You will help create accountability across internal and external teams.
You will:
Capture commitments made during meetings.
Clearly document the owner and expected completion date.
Follow up before deadlines rather than waiting until something becomes late.
Maintain visibility into outstanding deliverables.
Proactively contact internal and external stakeholders when information or action is required.
Escalate overdue or blocked items appropriately.
Close the loop when work has been completed.
Ensure decisions and changes are reflected in project documentation.

Success means leadership does not have to repeatedly ask, "Whatever happened with that?"

Your job is to already know the answer.
3. Client Success & Implementation Support Support Minerra Health's relationships with U.S.-based healthcare organizations.
Responsibilities may include:
Coordinate client deliverables and follow-up activities.
Maintain client project plans and action registers.
Prepare agendas, meeting notes, status reports, and follow-up communications.
Track implementation requirements and dependencies.
Support discovery and workflow documentation.
Coordinate activities involving clinical, technical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
Help prepare materials for client presentations, operating reviews, and executive discussions.
Identify client risks and unresolved issues requiring leadership attention.
Maintain professional and responsive communication with client stakeholders.

The successful candidate will understand that small operational details can have significant consequences for client confidence.
4. Meeting Management Meetings should produce decisions and actions—not simply notes.
You will:
Help develop agendas before meetings.
Identify outstanding decisions and actions that need discussion.
Capture decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines.
Distribute concise meeting summaries.
Enter resulting work into Jira or appropriate trackers.
Follow up on commitments between meetings.
Bring unresolved items back to the appropriate team or leader.

Over time, you will independently manage recurring operational and project meetings.
5. Executive & Presentation Support Help translate operational work into clear executive communication.
You may:
Develop and update PowerPoint presentations.
Prepare project status summaries.
Create timelines and executive dashboards.
Summarize project risks and decisions.
Prepare materials for client and leadership meetings.
Consolidate information from multiple teams into concise updates.
Perform research and analysis supporting strategic initiatives.

You should be able to take complicated information and make it understandable.

What We're Looking ForExperience Ideally, you have:
Approximately 2–5 years of experience
in project management, program coordination, operations, implementation, consulting, client success, or a related discipline.
Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience managing deadlines, dependencies, and action items.
Experience working remotely with distributed teams.
Strong written and spoken English.
Experience working with U.S.-based organizations or clients is strongly preferred.
Startup, technology, healthcare, consulting, SaaS, or digital-health experience is helpful but not mandatory.

Healthcare experience is valuable, but execution ability is more important than healthcare credentials
.
Education A bachelor's degree in business, project management, healthcare administration, engineering, technology, or a related field is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate
.
We value demonstrated capability over credentials.
A candidate with a modest academic background and an exceptional record of execution may be a stronger fit than someone with advanced degrees who requires constant direction.

Required Skills Candidates should demonstrate strong capability in:
Project management
Task and dependency tracking
Written business communication
Meeting facilitation and documentation
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft PowerPoint
Microsoft Word
Jira or comparable project-management software
Confluence or comparable knowledge-management software
Process and workflow documentation
Status reporting
Risk and issue tracking
Stakeholder management
Remote collaboration

Experience with HubSpot, Mixpanel, healthcare systems, EHRs, CRM platforms, analytics tools, or AI productivity tools is a plus.

Working Hours Because this role supports U.S.-based operations and clients, candidates must be willing and able to work primarily during U.S. business hours.

The schedule will require significant overlap with the U.S. team and U.S. client meetings.
There may also be limited situations where overlap with India-based team members is necessary for handoffs, coordination, or project execution.
Candidates should consider this requirement carefully before applying. This is not a traditional India daytime position.
How You Work We are looking for someone who:
Takes ownership.

You do not assume someone else is tracking an issue.
Follows through.

If someone promises something Tuesday, you know whether it arrived Wednesday.
Is persistent without being abrasive.

You are comfortable following up repeatedly when necessary while maintaining professional relationships.
Anticipates problems.

You raise risks before they become missed deadlines.
Creates structure from ambiguity.

Startup projects are not always perfectly defined. You can turn incomplete information into an organized plan.
Pays attention to details.

Names, dates, numbers, versions, owners, and commitments matter.
Communicates concisely.

You can tell leadership what happened, what is outstanding, why it matters, and what decision is needed.
Is comfortable asking questions.

You do not pretend to understand something you do not understand.
Gets things done.

Progress matters more than activity.

Align business targets, marketing initiatives, and operational goals with project outcomes.

Execution & Delivery

Assign and monitor project tasks, follow up on blockers, and manage resource allocation and costs.

Ensure adherence to testing, QA, and deployment standards to maintain high delivery quality.

Translate technical details into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders.
Manage communication with internal and external partners, ensuring transparency and expectation alignment.
Coordinate with third-party vendors, QA testers, and operations teams as needed.

Metrics & Reporting

Track and analyze key delivery metrics (e.g., cycle time, deployment frequency, defect rates).
Prepare structured reports for leadership, covering project progress, risks, and resource allocation.
Use data and feedback loops to recommend improvements and guide product roadmaps.

Qualifications:

Solid understanding of web development technologies (e.g., JavaScript, React, Node, Python, or PHP).
Experience in managing e-commerce platforms, internal tools, or automation systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable reading logs, tracing issues, or interpreting API specs.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like JIRA or Notion.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager- Launch Platforms
new_jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch seeks a Program Manager to deliver reliable and successful launch platform projects and flight-ready aircraft capability to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible for meeting schedule, cost, and technical objectives for all launch platform service-center related work. Candidates must have a strong sense of urgency, be dedicated to delivering to our customers, and be motivated to drive cross-functional teams to successfully operate our launch platforms. This role requires creative problem solving to significantly increase hypersonic test cadence while also driving affordability into mission operations. This role will require you to roll up your sleeves and work with a multi-faceted team to deliver for customers in a challenging operational environment.

You will work for the Stratolaunch Program Management department. In this role, you will own the integration of all Stratolaunch launch platform service-center projects. Launch platforms are both certified and experimental aircraft. You will own the cost, schedule, and technical integration of all launch platform activities. This includes managing schedules, planning cross-functional resources and staffing, creating budgets and forecasts, mitigating risks experienced in flight test, and delivering aircraft ready to achieve all test objectives. An optimal candidate will have a strong operational background in flight test execution, with experience modifying and integrating new technologies onto launch platforms. You will be responsible for drastically increasing our launch platform flight cadence, while also driving reliability and affordability initiatives into all launch platform projects. This role requires supporting flight test at all hours of the day and some travel to support global operations. You will work with the Stratolaunch finance and accounting office, operations team, and engineering team.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead the execution and integration of all launch platform service-center projects, delivering on-schedule, on-budget, and with completion of all project objectives.
Own launch platform risks. Mitigate the flight test risks and drive issues to closure with timely actions to ensure positive results are delivered to our customers.
Lead the service-center integration of one-off aircraft modification and aircraft maintenance projects.
Develop schedules and resource plans to complete all elements of launch platform execution.
Track maintenance and special-project costs over time and analyze variances. Accountable for achieving the launch platform budgets.
Support and plan for all variable flight costs, including fuel, maintenance, flight crew proficiency flights, etc.
Drive affordability and efficiency into launch platform execution to increase mission profitability.
Lead Program Reviews for all launch platforms.
Serve as a program representative in internal and customer-facing meetings, as required.
Work with Finance and company leadership to ensure planning and financial tracking processes and procedures meet US Government contracting requirements.
Develop and drive critical program management launch platform metrics for the program.
Coordinate and help resolve program financial challenges, as required.
Support the preparation of business proposals to the US Government and industry.
Travel, as required, to support launch platform execution.
Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity, and fulfillment of commitments.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

Knowledge of, and experience with, both certified and experimental heavy aircraft.
Knowledge of, and experience with, one or more of these disciplines: Flight and/or launch vehicle testing, aircraft maintenance, heavy aircraft integration and testing, flight test scheduling and cost tracking.
Experience leading and working with engineers, technicians, testers, and customers to deliver flight-ready aircraft.
Experience developing schedules and managing teams who are motivated to achieve challenging test goals.
Experience with program financial analysis, including variance analysis and developing forecasts.
Experience with driving risk and issues to closure in a timely manner.
Ability to develop and analyze data, and present findings to customers and management.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and ability to implement sound critical thinking skills.
Ability to work on their own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals.
Ability to work under tight deadlines, managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and changing environment.
Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

EDUCATION

Staff-level ($128,000-$206,000): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 10-20 years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Principal-level ($147,500-$237,200): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 20+ years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Supporting flight test often means contributing during off-nominal hours and weekends.
All candidates are expected to be onsite in Mojave >= 80% of normal work days.
Travel estimated to be approximately 10% or less.

new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of electrical, mechanical, structural, and hardware engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Fleet Remediation Engineering specializes in retrofit efforts that span several engineering disciplines and is applied across a variety of data center infrastructure designs. We align stakeholders to place a high focus on engineering design quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, and most ambiguous infrastructure retrofit efforts within the existing AWS data center community. By continuously mapping priorities defined via AWS’ Capital Improvement Prioritization Program (CIPP), we invest the proper time and effort into projects that achieve the largest bottom-line impact for the business. We are passionate about ensuring our latest innovations are implemented into our existing fleet to provide maximum benefit on behalf of our customers, and get our energy through challenge, innovation and design.

Requirements

We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to support our data center retrofit programs that modernize and improve our extensive data center fleet. The TPM will lead cross functional and technical teams to drive projects from concept to requirements definition, feasibility assessments, designs, implementation, testing, and deployment. The TPM will develop the strategy for the retrofit of the existing data center fleet with the latest generation of mechanical & electrical products to meet the latest design standards. Additionally, the TPM will lead initiatives associated with the global Fleet Remediation Engineering portfolio, developing or enhancing systems, tools, & mechanisms to streamline project delivery. At Amazon, along with technical strength, we expect our TPMs to interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to understand our joint business goals and priorities, and to execute rapidly, delivering high-quality functionality. The TPM will apply their expertise to:

Develop the path and strategy for incorporation of the latest mechanical & electrical engineering solutions to existing data center fleet.
Lead cross functional and technical teams to drive projects from concept to requirements definition, feasibility assessments, designs, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Evaluate the requirements and actions that enable delivery of the mechanical & electrical programs in our fleet of existing data centers.
Prioritize programs within the portfolio based on technical risks and gain alignment on that prioritization.

At Amazon, along with technical strength, we expect our TPMs to interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to understand our joint business goals and priorities, and to execute rapidly, delivering high-quality functionality.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These capital improvements to our data centers are essential for meeting our customers’ expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon’s goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers to hyper-scale. This role provides a unique opportunity to engage with cloud infrastructure at a large scale and the exceptional people that design and implement solutions and operate the infrastructure for the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical electrical engineering initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments, R&D projects, and understanding of SQL data bases is a plus. A Bachelor's Degree or additional technical experience is required. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, electrical engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

Candidate must be comfortable managing conceptual development efforts, remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project or initiative implementation issues, and remove barriers to project or initiative success. Being able to evaluate project or initiative feasibility, create cross-functional matrix-based teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project or initiative delivery is a must.

The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking.

Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, MS SharePoint and Smartsheet.

A day in the life

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex capital improvement programs and affiliated systems. You prioritize your activities to support and understand the projects’ status, solve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for program success.

About The Team

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Those programs will have to accomplish aspects of a business's larger strategy as well specific technical requirement. Develop and handle breakthroughs and schedules for the many moving parts that need to come together. Coordinate, plan and execute the NVIDIA Enterprise Products system level integration and requirements into specific tasks and assignments of those tasks to relevant functional areas in coordination with a large OEM System Partner.
Collecting, prioritizing, tracking, and driving customer-reported issues to resolution/closure is a key focus of this role.
Clearly and thoughtfully communicate issue status to the customer and to internal NVIDIA Executive teams.
Work closely with engineering, operations, quality, product management, and sales teams to resolve planning, technical and logistical issues, set correct expectations and keep the scope of the projects on a track to successful execution.
Efficiently coordinate and lead complex technical engineering-to-engineering (hardware and software) discussions.
Properly represent the sense of urgency of issues and raise them (internally and/or externally) as appropriate.
Regularly communicate executive level program report status and key issues to management.
Develop a close working relationship with customer development teams and use creativity to find the best solution. You are a system builder with good solid understanding of assembling and connecting workstation system components such as GPUs, CPUs, memory, networking, and storage systems.

What We Need To See

BS/MS Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
12+ years in High-Tech industry with a focus on Technical Program Management, supporting OEMs/ODMs Enterprise System Partners.
Proven deep customer savvy born of performing complex programs, especially with strategic customers related to Enterprise System Platforms with Tier-1 OEMs.
Technical savvy, including hardware and software engineering, network topologies, network interfaces and system level qualification/deployment requirements.
Supreme leadership skills across broad and diverse functional teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges.

Solid experience in working with large OEMs/ODMs for server system integration, development and deployment with bold timelines and/or constrained resources.

Consistent record of handling multiple OEMs/ODMs System Partners and Programs across worldwide geographies and time zones.
